CODE2 reads comp_2 and an opaque age file, creates age/stability and rolling-ten-year sale_std outputs, but does not merge them into reg12 or write the CODE3 input. Confirm branch scope and intended consumer before classifying as optional or editing.

The supplied Internet Appendix reports Tables OA1–OA9 and Figures OA1–OA2, including Census-HHI, event-window, additional capital-market/state-variable, Compustat/small-business, leverage/capital-structure, NETS pseudo-segment and random-date analyses. README identifies CODE3 only for Table 2; no appendix program/input mapping is supplied.
CODE2 depends on external [redacted-path-36c2397a51fe] and WRDS SAS/CONNECT signon; the include body and connection setup are outside the package. Current access is unverified, not proven absent.
CODE1 uses `sic` while the observed local COMP.FUNDA candidate has `sich`, not `sic`. The author extract may differ; confirm mapping before claiming compatibility or proposing edits.

CODE1/CODE2 create names such as RD_to_Sales, Intangible_to_AT, Advertise_to_sale, LnAT, ABROA_persistence, bigN, GDPGR and nAnalysts, while CODE3 refers to lowercase names such as rd_to_sales, lnat, abroa_persistence, bign, gdpgr and nanalysts. Stata names are case-sensitive, but the missing DTA producer/export step means any case normalization is undocumented and cannot be verified. Confirm the actual handoff schema before proposing renames.

CODE1/CODE2 bind idd, pead and con to literal Windows roots and also contain literal Windows file paths for inputs/intermediates. CODE3 reads all data5.dta by a Windows absolute path and writes IDD_TABLE2.csv relative to its working directory. The package supplies no confirmed runtime root, staging or output mapping; do not infer a POSIX replacement or conversion.
